```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Creating the DataFrame from the provided data
data = {
    'StichtagDat': ['2024-12-31', '2025-12-31', '2019-12-31', '2020-12-31', '2021-12-31'],
    'AlterV10Lang': ['30- bis 39-Jährige'] * 5,
    'KreisLang': ['Kreis 7', 'Kreis 7', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10'],
    'AnzHunde': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert StichtagDat to datetime for better plotting
df['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(df['StichtagDat'])

# Set the plot style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=df, x='StichtagDat', hue='KreisLang', dodge=True)

# Adding titles and labels
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Date and District')
plt.xlabel('Date')
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='District')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
```
